name: Canned Bartlett Pear Halves in 100% Juice or Water
whyItWorks: Canned pears have the abrasive skins and fibrous cores completely removed, and the heat-canning process breaks down hemicellulose into tender, easily digested fruit flesh. They are exceptionally low in acid and gentle on ulcerated intestines.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain the packing juice or water to reduce free liquid sugars. Eat pear halves with a spoon; they require virtually zero digestive mechanical effort.
watchOuts: Avoid canned pears packed in heavy corn syrup; opt for pear juice, light juice, or water pack.
